ko.title: 미국의 상수도망에 누군가 노크하고 있다: 해커들이 7개 주의 유틸리티 시설을 공격하다

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: 최근 며칠 사이 사례를 확인한 관계자들과 주 정부 기관들에 따르면, 연방 수사관들이 최소 7개 주에 걸쳐 퍼져 있는 시 상수도 시스템의 일련의 컴퓨터 침입 사건을 조사하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: 미시간주 당국은 주 내 9개 유틸리티 시설이 영향을 받았다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: 미네소타주의 집계는 더 많으며, 30개 이상의 시스템이 검토 대상으로 분류되었습니다.

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: 지금까지 관계자들이 전한 메시지는 한 가지 점에서 일관되었습니다. 식수 자체가 변경된 것으로 알려진 바 없으며, 누군가의 수도꼭지가 안전하지 않다는 징후는 없다는 것입니다.

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: 하지만 이번 사건들은 물 전문가들이 수년 동안 조용히 말해온 어떤 사실의 베일을 벗겼습니다.

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: 미국에는 단 '하나의' 물 시스템이 존재하지 않습니다.

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: 수만 개의 시스템이 있으며, 대부분 규모가 작고 지역적으로 운영되며, 상당수는 중소기업의 IT 부서 예산으로도 감당하지 못할 정도의 예산으로 방어되고 있습니다.

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *이 이야기는 현재 진행 중인 사건입니다.

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: 주 및 연방 기관이 보고한 세부 사항은 조사가 계속됨에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## 관계자들이 설명한 내용

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: 이번 활동은 침입자들이 수도 유틸리티의 운영 측면, 즉 청구 서버나 이메일 계정이 아니라 실제로 밸브를 열고 펌프를 가동하며 화학 물질을 투입하는 시스템에 접근하려 한다는 연방 권고안이 발표된 후 더 널리 알려지게 되었습니다.

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: 그 후 주 환경 및 공공 안전 기관들은 관할 구역 내의 유틸리티 시설들에 연락하여 로그와 장비를 점검하기 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: 미시간주 환경부는 9개의 시스템이 영향을 받았음을 확인했습니다.

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: 미네소타주 관계자들은 30개 이상의 시스템을 대상으로 한 더 광범위한 검토 내용을 설명했습니다.

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: 다른 주들도 수치를 공개하지 않은 채 사례가 있음을 인정했으며, 연방 수사관들은 이번 사건들을 일련의 우연이 아니라 하나의 패턴의 일부로 다루고 있습니다.

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: 관계자들은 일반적으로 개별 유틸리티 시설의 이름을 밝히기를 거부했는데, 이는 조사가 진행 중일 때의 표준 관행입니다.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: 취약점이 알려진 시스템 목록을 공개하는 것은 명백한 이유로 기관들이 서둘러 할 일이 아닙니다.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: 공개적으로 언급된 내용은 제한적이며 문자 그대로 읽을 가치가 있습니다. 수질의 확인된 변경 없음, 고객에 대한 확인된 피해 없음, 서비스의 확인된 중단 없음.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: 이것이 아무 일도 일어나지 않았다는 말과 같은 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: 그것은 결과가 물까지 도달하지 않았음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## 대부분의 사람들이 생각하지 않는 유틸리티의 부분

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: 모든 물 시스템은 두 개의 분리된 기술 세계에서 작동합니다.

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: 첫 번째는 일반적인 사무용 IT입니다. 이메일, 청구, 급여, 요금을 결제하는 고객 포털 등이 여기에 해당합니다.

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: 두 번째는 **운영 기술**(Operational Technology), 즉 OT입니다. 공장을 물리적으로 가동하는 산업 제어 장비입니다.

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: 센서가 탱크 수위를 보고합니다.

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: 컨트롤러가 펌프를 시작해야 한다고 결정합니다.

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: 제어실의 화면은 운영자에게 공장이 어떻게 작동하고 있는지 보여주며, 운영자가 이를 조정할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: 이 두 번째 세계는 대부분 수십 년 전, 제어 패널에 접근하는 유일한 방법이 직접 걸어가는 것이었던 시대에 설계되었습니다.

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: 당시의 우선순위는 인증이 아니라 가동 시간과 예측 가능성이었습니다.

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: 그러다 점차, 그리고 매우 합리적인 이유로 일부 부분이 연결되었습니다. 기술자가 새벽 2시에 원격 펌프 스테이션을 확인할 수 있도록 하기 위해서였습니다.

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: 40마일을 운전하지 않고도, 벤더가 펌웨어 업데이트를 밀어넣을 수 있도록, 그리고 직원이 3명뿐인 소규모 유틸리티 시설이 카운티 크기의 서비스 지역을 담당할 수 있도록 말입니다.

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: 이러한 각각의 편의성은 또한 하나의 문이 됩니다.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: 조사 중인 침입 사건들은 바로 이 범주의 문, 즉 유틸리티 시설이 시간과 비용을 들여 설치한 보안 장치로 보호되는 원격 접속 가능 제어 인터페이스와 관련이 있는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: 보안 연구원들은 오랫동안 이 구체적인 노출 지점을 지적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: 인터넷에 연결된 장치를 목록화하는 스캐닝 도구들은 공개된 상태로 방치된 산업 제어 인터페이스를 일상적으로 찾아냅니다.

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: 그중 일부는 물 시스템에 속해 있습니다.

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: 이를 찾는 데 국가 수준의 예산이 필요하지 않으며, 이것이 바로 이 위험이 해결되기 어려운 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## 물이 여전히 거의 확실히 안전한 이유

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: "관계자들이 안전하다고 말한다"는 말보다 더 강력한 답변을 원하는 것은 당연합니다.

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: 이 안심시키는 말이 신뢰할 수 있는 구조적 이유는 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: 수처리는 **중복성**(redundancy)을 기반으로 구축되었으며, 이는 해커를 걱정하기 훨씬 전부터 그렇게 설계되었습니다.

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: 장비는 고장 나고 사람은 실수하기 때문에 그렇게 만들어진 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **물리적 한계.** 화학물질 투입 시스템은 일반적으로 펌프가 최대 속도로 작동하더라도 범위를 크게 벗어난 용량을 투입할 수 없도록 설계됩니다. 배관이 물리적으로 할 수 없는 일을 공장이 하게 만들 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **지속적인 모니터링.** 처리된 물은 잔류 염소, 탁도, pH 등을 위해 끊임없이 테스트됩니다. 측정값이 벗어나면 알람이 울리는 장비와 그 뒤를 잇는 실험실 샘플 분석이 이를 수행합니다.

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **인적 운영자.** 인증된 운영자들이 공장을 감시합니다. 제어 화면에 불가능한 명령이 표시되는 것은 바로 그들이 포착하고 무효화하도록 훈련받은 종류의 상황입니다.

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **수동 제어.** 거의 모든 자동 기능에는 로컬의 물리적 대체 수단이 있습니다. 운영자들은 공장을 수동으로 가동할 수 있으며 실제로 그렇게 하기도 합니다.

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **시간.** 물은 처리 시설에서 수도꼭지까지 즉시 이동하지 않습니다. 저장 및 배수 과정을 거치며, 이 과정에서 몇 시간의 완충 시간과 희석 효과가 추가됩니다.

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: 이러한 층들을 함께 고려하면 그림이 더 명확해집니다. 제어 인터페이스에 도달하는 것은 유틸리티의 경계 보안에 심각한 침해가 발생한 것이지만, 그것이 수도꼭지에서 나오는 물을 제어하는 것과 같지는 않습니다.

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년 동안 공개적으로 알려진 유사한 사례들에서 그 간극은 유지되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## 진짜 취약점은 산술에 있다

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: 이 이야기에서 불편한 부분은 단일 침입 사건이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: 그것은 공격 표면의 규모입니다.

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: 미국 전역에는 약 50,000개의 지역 사회 물 시스템이 있습니다.

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: 압도적 다수인 약 10개 중 9개가 10,000명 미만의 사람들에게 서비스를 제공합니다.

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: 이들은 마을, 학구, 모바일 홈 파크, 농촌 협동조합들입니다.

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: 주민 2,000명에게 서비스를 제공하는 시스템은 총 몇 명의 직원만을 고용할 수 있으며, 그들 모두는 물이 깨끗하고 수압이 유지되는지 확인하는 데 집중합니다.

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: 그 유틸리티 시설에 네트워크 분리, 다요소 인증, 패치된 원격 접속 소프트웨어, 로깅 및 사고 대응 계획까지 유지하라고 요구하는 것은, 직원 중에 존재하지 않는 전문 지식과 요금 기반에 존재하지 않는 돈을 요구하는 것과 같습니다.

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: 사이버 보안 자금을 마련하기 위해 수도 요금을 인상하는 것은 어떤 마을 회의에서도 받아들이기 힘든 제안입니다.

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: 규제 또한 이 문제로 어려움을 겪어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: 연방법은 3,300명 이상에게 서비스를 제공하는 대규모 시스템이 사이버 보안을 포함한 위험 및 회복력 평가를 실시하도록 요구하지만, 그 요구 사항은 주기적이며 자기 주도적입니다.

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: 2023년에 사이버 보안 점검을 정기적인 주 위생 조사에 포함시키려던 시도는 주 정부와 산업 단체들의 법적 이의 제기 이후 철회되었습니다.

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: 그 결과, 모범 사례가 강력히 권장되고 널리 공개되어 있지만, 채택 정도는 불균형한 분야가 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 일어날 일

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: 연방 사이버 및 환경 기관들은 물 분야의 정보 공유 조직과 함께 유틸리티 시설들에 지침과 무료 평가 서비스를 제공해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: 즉각적인 요구 사항들은 화려하지 않고 구체적입니다. 제어 인터페이스를 공개 인터넷에서 제거하고, 기본 자격 증명을 교체하며, 원격 접속에 다요소 인증을 활성화하고, 컨트롤러 설정의 오프라인 백업을 유지하며, 새벽 3시에 누구에게 전화해야 하는지 누군가는 알게 하는 것입니다.

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 새로운 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: 새로운 점이 있다면 정치적 관심일 것입니다.

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: 단일 사건은 헤드라인이 되지만, 7개 주에 걸친 수십 개의 유틸리티 시설은 패턴이 되며, 예산을 움직이는 것은 바로 이러한 패턴입니다.

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: 주민들이 취해야 할 조치는 없으며, 물 사용 방식을 바꿀 이유도 없습니다.

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: 지역 유틸리티 시설은 식수가 안전 기준을 충족하지 못할 경우 고객에게 통지해야 할 의무가 있으며, 연례 수질 보고서는 여러분이 무엇을 마시고 있는지 실제로 알려주는 문서로 남을 것입니다.

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: 자신의 시스템이 어떻게 운영되고 있는지 알고 싶다면, 그 보고서와 공개적으로 진행되는 유틸리티 이사회 회의를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: 누구도 다른 사람의 물에 독을 타지 않았습니다.

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: 대안적인 프레임은 빠르게 퍼지며 누구에게도 도움이 되지 않기 때문에, 이 점을 분명히 말할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: 실제로 일어난 일은 많은 사람이 얼마나 많은 앞문이 있는지, 그리고 그중 얼마나 많은 문이 잠겨 있지 않았는지를 발견했다는 것입니다.

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: 이 사건이 공중 보건 위기로 번지는 것을 막은 방어선은 주로 물리적 한계, 화학, 게이지를 감시하는 숙련된 운영자라는 오래된 것들이었습니다.

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: 그것들은 좋은 방어선입니다.

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: 하지만 그것들은 첫 번째 방어선이 아니라 마지막 방어선입니다.

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: 이번 사건이 남긴 질문은, 국가가 50,000개의 서로 다른 주소에 첫 번째 방어선을 구축하기 위해 기꺼이 비용을 지불할 의사가 있느냐는 것입니다.

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: 지금까지 그 답은 각각의 시설에 개별적으로 맡겨져 왔습니다.

zh.title: 有人在敲击美国的供水系统：黑客攻击七个州的公用事业机构

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: 根据官员和近日确认病例的国家机构，联邦调查人员正在调查分布在至少七个州的市政供水系统的计算机入侵集群。

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: 密歇根州当局表示，该州有九家公用事业机构受到影响。

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: 明尼苏达州的统计数字更高——超过三十个系统被标记为需要审查。

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: 到目前为止，官员们传达的信息在一点上是一致的：目前尚不清楚饮用水本身是否被篡改，也没有迹象表明任何人的水龙头是不安全的。

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: 但这些事件揭开了水务专业人士多年来一直在低声讨论的事情。

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: 美国并没有*一个*供水系统。

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: 它有数以万计的系统，其中大多数规模较小，大多数由当地运行，而且许多系统的防御预算甚至不足以支撑一家中型公司的 IT 部门。

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *这是一个正在发展的故事。

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: 随着调查的继续，州和联邦机构报告的细节可能会发生变化。*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## 官员们的描述

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: 在联邦咨询警告称，入侵者正试图接触水务公用事业的运营端——不是计费服务器或电子邮件账户，而是实际开启阀门、运行泵和投放化学制剂的系统之后，这一活动引起了更广泛的关注。

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: 随后，各州的环境和公共安全机构开始联系其管辖范围内的公用事业机构，以检查日志和设备。

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: 密歇根州环境部确认有九个系统受到影响。

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: 明尼苏达州官员描述了一次涉及三十多个系统的更广泛审查。

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: 其他一些州承认发生了此类案例，但未公布具体数量，联邦调查人员将这些事件视为一种模式，而非一系列巧合。

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: 官员们通常拒绝透露具体公用事业机构的名称，这是调查期间的标准做法。

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: 出于显而易见的原因，机构不会急于公布一份已知存在弱点的系统名单。

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: 公开披露的信息非常有限，且应字面理解：没有确认的水质变化，没有确认的客户损害，也没有确认的服务中断。

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: 这并不等同于说什么都没有发生。

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: 这意味着后果还没有影响到水质。

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## 大多数人从未考虑过的公用事业部分

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: 每个供水系统都运行在两个独立的技术世界中。

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: 第一个是普通的办公 IT——电子邮件、计费、工资单，以及您支付账单的客户门户网站。

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: 第二个是**运营技术**，或 OT：物理运行工厂的工业控制设备。

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: 传感器报告水箱液位。

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: 控制器决定启动水泵。

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: 控制室的屏幕向操作员显示工厂的运行情况，并允许他们进行调整。

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: 在大多数情况下，第二个世界是在几十年前设计的，当时接触控制面板的唯一方法就是走到它面前。

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: 它的优先级是运行时间和可预测性，而不是身份验证。

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: 然后，出于完全合理的原因，它的一部分逐渐被连接了起来——这样技术人员就可以在凌晨 2 点检查远程泵站。

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: 而无需驾驶 40 英里，这样供应商就可以推送固件更新，这样只有三名员工的小型公用事业机构就可以覆盖一个县规模的服务区域。

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: 每一种便利都是一扇门。

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: 目前正在调查的入侵事件似乎涉及这类门：远程可访问的控制接口，其保护措施取决于公用事业机构投入的时间和资金。

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: 安全研究人员长期以来一直指出这一特定的暴露点。

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: 编录联网设备的扫描工具经常发现公开暴露的工业控制接口。

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: 其中一些属于供水系统。

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: 寻找这些接口不需要国家级的预算——这也是风险如此难以根除的部分原因。

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## 为什么水质几乎肯定仍然没问题

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: 想要一个比“官员说它是安全的”更强有力的答案是合理的。

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: 以下是这种保证可信的结构性原因。

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: 水处理是建立在**冗余**基础之上的，而且早在人们担心黑客之前，它就是这样设计的。

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: 这样设计是因为设备会故障，人会犯错。

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **物理限制。** 化学投加系统通常在尺寸上经过设计，使得即使水泵以最大功率运行，也无法提供严重超出范围的剂量。你无法让工厂执行管道物理上无法完成的操作。

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **持续监测。** 处理后的水会不断地进行测试——余氯、浊度、pH 值——由在读数漂移时会报警的仪器以及随后的实验室样本来完成。

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **人工操作员。** 持证操作员负责监控工厂。控制屏幕上显示出不可信的命令，正是他们接受培训以捕捉并覆盖的操作。

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **手动控制。** 几乎每个自动化功能都有本地物理备份。操作员可以且确实在手动运行工厂。

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **时间。** 水从处理到水龙头并不是瞬间完成的。它经过存储和分配，这增加了数小时的缓冲和稀释。

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: 将这些因素叠加在一起，情况就变得更清晰了：接触控制接口是公用事业机构周边的严重突破，但这并不等同于控制你水龙头里流出的水。

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: 在过去几年中公开披露的此类案例中，这个差距一直存在。

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## 真正的漏洞是算术问题

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: 这个故事中令人不安的部分不是任何一次单一的入侵。

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: 而是攻击面的规模。

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: 全国大约有 50,000 个社区供水系统。

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: 绝大多数——大约十分之九——服务人口少于 10,000 人。

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: 这些是村庄、学区、移动房屋公园、农村合作社。

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: 一个服务 2,000 名居民的系统可能总共只雇佣了几个人，他们全部专注于确保水质清洁且压力稳定。

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: 要求该公用事业机构同时维护网络分段、多因素身份验证、打补丁的远程访问软件、日志记录和事件响应计划，你是在要求一种员工队伍中不存在的专业知识，以及费率基数中不存在的资金。

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: 在任何城镇会议上，提高水费以资助网络安全都是很难被接受的。

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: 监管部门在这一问题上也举步维艰。

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: 联邦法律要求较大的系统——服务人口超过 3,300 人的系统——进行包括网络安全在内的风险和韧性评估，但该要求是周期性的且由其自行主导。

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: 2023 年一次尝试将网络安全检查纳入常规州卫生调查的尝试，在遭到州和行业团体的法律挑战后被撤回。

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: 结果就是，在这个行业中，良好实践被强烈鼓励，被广泛公布，但被不均匀地采用。

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: 联邦网络和环境机构以及水务部门自己的信息共享组织已经向公用事业机构推送了指南和免费评估服务。

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: 眼下的要求虽然枯燥且具体：将控制接口移出公开互联网，更换默认凭据，为远程访问开启多因素身份验证，保留控制器配置的离线备份，并确保有人知道在凌晨 3 点该给谁打电话。

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: 这些都不是新建议。

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: 可能是新的是政治关注度。

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: 一次单一事件是一个头条新闻；分布在七个州的数十家公用事业机构则是一个模式，而模式才是推动预算变动的因素。

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: 对于居民来说，不需要采取任何行动，也没有理由改变你使用水的方式。

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: 如果饮用水未能达到安全标准，当地公用事业机构必须通知客户，而你的年度水质报告仍然是真正告诉你饮用什么水的文档。

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: 如果你想知道自己的系统运行如何，那份报告——以及公开的公用事业机构董事会会议——就是查看的地方。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: 没有人给任何人的水投毒。

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: 这一点需要直白地说，因为另一种解读方式传播很快且对任何人都没有帮助。

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: 真正发生的是，很多人发现了这里有多少扇前门，以及其中有多少扇是没有锁的。

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: 防止这件事演变成公共卫生事件的防御措施在很大程度上是旧的——物理限制、化学、监控仪表盘的培训操作员。

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: 这些是很好的防御措施。

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: 但它们也是最后一道防线，而不是第一道。

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: 这次事件留下的问题是，这个国家是否愿意为 50,000 个独立地址的第一道防线买单。

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: 到目前为止，这个答案一直由他们各自独立决定。

hi.title: कोई अमेरिका की जल आपूर्ति पर दस्तक दे रहा है: हैकर्स ने सात राज्यों की उपयोगिताओं को निशाना बनाया

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: संघीय जांचकर्ता कम से कम सात राज्यों में फैले नगर निगम जल प्रणालियों में कंप्यूटर घुसपैठ के एक समूह की जांच कर रहे हैं, अधिकारियों और राज्य एजेंसियों ने हाल के दिनों में मामलों की पुष्टि की है।

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: मिशिगन अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि राज्य की नौ उपयोगिताओं (utilities) पर असर पड़ा है।

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: मिनेसोटा की गिनती बड़ी है — समीक्षा के लिए तीस से अधिक प्रणालियों को चिह्नित किया गया है।

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों का संदेश अब तक एक बिंदु पर सुसंगत रहा है: यह ज्ञात नहीं है कि पीने के पानी में कोई बदलाव किया गया है, और ऐसा कोई संकेत नहीं है कि किसी का नल असुरक्षित है।

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: लेकिन इन घटनाओं ने उस पर्दे को हटा दिया है जिसे जल पेशेवर वर्षों से चुपचाप कह रहे थे।

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के पास *एक* जल प्रणाली नहीं है।

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: इसके पास उनमें से हजारों हैं, जिनमें से अधिकांश छोटे हैं, अधिकांश स्थानीय रूप से संचालित हैं, और उनमें से कई एक ऐसे बजट द्वारा सुरक्षित हैं जो एक मध्यम आकार की कंपनी के आईटी विभाग को भी कवर नहीं करेगा।

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *यह एक विकसित होती कहानी है।

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: जांच जारी रहने तक राज्य और संघीय एजेंसियों द्वारा रिपोर्ट किए गए विवरण बदल सकते हैं।*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## अधिकारियों ने क्या बताया

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: इस गतिविधि पर व्यापक ध्यान तब गया जब एक संघीय सलाहकार ने चेतावनी दी कि घुसपैठिये जल उपयोगिताओं के परिचालन पक्ष (operational side) तक पहुँचने की कोशिश कर रहे थे — बिलिंग सर्वर या ईमेल खातों तक नहीं, बल्कि उन प्रणालियों तक जो वास्तव में वाल्व खोलती हैं, पंप चलाती हैं और रसायनों की खुराक देती हैं।

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: राज्य पर्यावरण और सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा एजेंसियों ने फिर अपनी सीमाओं के भीतर उपयोगिताओं से संपर्क करना शुरू किया ताकि लॉग और उपकरणों की जांच की जा सके।

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: मिशिगन के पर्यावरण विभाग ने नौ प्रभावित प्रणालियों की पुष्टि की।

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: मिनेसोटा के अधिकारियों ने तीस से अधिक प्रणालियों को छूने वाली एक व्यापक समीक्षा का वर्णन किया।

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: अन्य राज्यों ने गिनती प्रकाशित किए बिना मामलों को स्वीकार किया है, और संघीय जांचकर्ता इन घटनाओं को संयोगों की एक श्रृंखला के बजाय एक पैटर्न के हिस्से के रूप में देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने आम तौर पर व्यक्तिगत उपयोगिताओं के नाम बताने से इनकार कर दिया है, जो जांच खुली होने के दौरान एक मानक अभ्यास है।

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: ज्ञात कमजोरियों वाली प्रणालियों की सूची प्रकाशित करना, स्पष्ट कारणों से, ऐसी चीज़ नहीं है जिसे एजेंसियां जल्दबाजी में करें।

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक रूप से जो कहा गया है वह सीमित है और उसे शाब्दिक रूप से पढ़ना उचित है: पानी की गुणवत्ता में कोई पुष्ट बदलाव नहीं, किसी भी ग्राहक को कोई पुष्ट नुकसान नहीं, और सेवा में कोई पुष्ट व्यवधान नहीं।

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: यह कहना कि कुछ नहीं हुआ, उससे अलग है।

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि परिणाम पानी तक नहीं पहुंचे।

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## उपयोगिता का वह हिस्सा जिसके बारे में अधिकांश लोग कभी नहीं सोचते

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक जल प्रणाली तकनीक की दो अलग-अलग दुनियाओं पर चलती है।

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: पहली साधारण ऑफिस आईटी है — ईमेल, बिलिंग, पेरोल, ग्राहक पोर्टल जहाँ आप अपना बिल भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: दूसरी **परिचालन तकनीक (operational technology)**, या OT है: औद्योगिक नियंत्रण उपकरण जो भौतिक रूप से प्लांट को चलाते हैं।

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: सेंसर टैंक के स्तर की रिपोर्ट करते हैं।

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: एक कंट्रोलर तय करता है कि पंप शुरू होना चाहिए।

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: कंट्रोल रूम में एक स्क्रीन ऑपरेटर को दिखाती है कि प्लांट क्या कर रहा है और उन्हें इसे समायोजित करने की अनुमति देती है।

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: वह दूसरी दुनिया, अधिकांश मामलों में, दशकों पहले डिज़ाइन की गई थी, उस समय के लिए जब कंट्रोल पैनल तक पहुँचने का एकमात्र तरीका उसके पास चलना था।

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: इसकी प्राथमिकता अपटाइम और पूर्वानुमान क्षमता थी, प्रमाणीकरण (authentication) नहीं।

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: फिर, धीरे-धीरे और पूरी तरह से समझदारी भरे कारणों से, इसके कुछ हिस्से जुड़ गए — ताकि एक तकनीशियन रात 2 बजे रिमोट पंप स्टेशन की जांच कर सके।

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: बिना चालीस मील गाड़ी चलाए, ताकि एक विक्रेता फर्मवेयर अपडेट पुश कर सके, ताकि तीन कर्मचारियों वाली एक छोटी उपयोगिता एक काउंटी के आकार के सेवा क्षेत्र को कवर कर सके।

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: उनमें से प्रत्येक सुविधा एक दरवाजा भी है।

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: जांच के तहत घुसपैठ में उस श्रेणी के दरवाजे शामिल प्रतीत होते हैं: रिमोटली पहुँचने योग्य नियंत्रण इंटरफेस, जिन्हें उपयोगिता ने समय और पैसे के अनुसार सुरक्षित किया था।

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: सुरक्षा शोधकर्ता लंबे समय से इस विशिष्ट जोखिम की ओर इशारा कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: स्कैनिंग टूल जो इंटरनेट से जुड़े उपकरणों की सूची बनाते हैं, नियमित रूप से खुले में बैठे औद्योगिक नियंत्रण इंटरफेस खोज निकालते हैं।

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: उनमें से कुछ जल प्रणालियों के हैं।

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: उन्हें खोजने के लिए किसी राष्ट्र-राज्य के बजट की आवश्यकता नहीं होती — जो इस जोखिम को इतना जिद्दी बनाता है।

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## पानी अभी भी लगभग निश्चित रूप से ठीक क्यों है

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: यह उचित है कि आप "अधिकारियों का कहना है कि यह सुरक्षित है" से अधिक मजबूत उत्तर चाहते हैं।

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: यहाँ वह संरचनात्मक कारण है जिससे यह आश्वासन विश्वसनीय है।

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: जल उपचार **रिडंडेंसी (redundancy)** पर आधारित है, और इसे हैकर्स की चिंता होने से बहुत पहले इसी तरह बनाया गया था।

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: इसे इस तरह बनाया गया था क्योंकि उपकरण विफल होते हैं और लोग गलतियाँ करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **भौतिक सीमाएँ।** केमिकल फीड सिस्टम आमतौर पर इस तरह से आकार दिए जाते हैं कि अधिकतम गति पर चलने वाला पंप भी सीमा से बाहर खुराक नहीं दे सके। आप प्लांट से वह काम नहीं करा सकते जो प्लंबिंग भौतिक रूप से नहीं कर सकती।

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **निरंतर निगरानी।** उपचारित पानी का लगातार परीक्षण किया जाता है — क्लोरीन अवशिष्ट, टर्बिडिटी, pH के लिए — उन उपकरणों द्वारा जो रीडिंग बदलने पर अलार्म बजाते हैं, और उसके बाद लैब नमूनों द्वारा।

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **मानव ऑपरेटर।** प्रमाणित ऑपरेटर प्लांट की निगरानी करते हैं। एक कंट्रोल स्क्रीन जो एक असंभव कमांड दिखाती है, ठीक वही चीज़ है जिसे पकड़ने और ओवरराइड करने के लिए उन्हें प्रशिक्षित किया गया है।

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **मैनुअल नियंत्रण।** लगभग हर स्वचालित कार्य का एक स्थानीय, भौतिक विकल्प होता है। ऑपरेटर प्लांट को हाथ से चला सकते हैं और चलाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **समय।** पानी उपचार से नल तक तुरंत नहीं पहुँचता। यह भंडारण और वितरण के माध्यम से चलता है, जो घंटों का बफर और डाइल्यूशन जोड़ता है।

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: इन सबको एक साथ जोड़ें और तस्वीर स्पष्ट हो जाती है: कंट्रोल इंटरफेस तक पहुँचना उपयोगिता की सुरक्षा सीमा का एक गंभीर उल्लंघन है, लेकिन यह आपके नल से निकलने वाले पानी को नियंत्रित करने के समान नहीं है।

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: पिछले कुछ वर्षों में इस तरह के सार्वजनिक रूप से ज्ञात मामलों में, यह अंतर बना रहा।

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## असली भेद्यता अंकगणित है

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: इस कहानी का असहज हिस्सा कोई एक घुसपैठ नहीं है।

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: यह सतह क्षेत्र का पैमाना है।

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: देश में लगभग 50,000 सामुदायिक जल प्रणालियाँ हैं।

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: भारी बहुमत — लगभग दस में से नौ — 10,000 से कम लोगों की सेवा करते हैं।

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: ये गाँव, स्कूल जिले, मोबाइल होम पार्क, ग्रामीण सहकारी समितियाँ हैं।

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: 2,000 निवासियों की सेवा करने वाली एक प्रणाली में कुल मिलाकर कुछ ही लोग कार्यरत हो सकते हैं, जो सभी यह सुनिश्चित करने पर केंद्रित हैं कि पानी साफ है और दबाव बना रहे।

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: उस उपयोगिता से नेटवर्क सेगमेंटेशन, मल्टीफैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन, पैच किए गए रिमोट-एक्सेस सॉफ्टवेयर, लॉगिंग और एक घटना प्रतिक्रिया योजना बनाए रखने के लिए कहें, और आप उस विशेषज्ञता की मांग कर रहे हैं जो स्टाफ में मौजूद नहीं है और उस पैसे की जो रेट बेस में नहीं है।

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: साइबर सुरक्षा के लिए धन जुटाने के लिए पानी की दरों को बढ़ाना किसी भी टाउन मीटिंग में बेचना मुश्किल होता है।

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: विनियमन (Regulation) भी इससे जूझ रहा है।

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: संघीय कानून बड़ी प्रणालियों — उन प्रणालियों की सेवा करने वाले 3,300 से अधिक लोगों — को जोखिम और लचीलापन आकलन करने की आवश्यकता होती है जिसमें साइबर सुरक्षा शामिल है, लेकिन वह आवश्यकता समय-समय पर और स्व-निर्देशित होती है।

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: 2023 में साइबर सुरक्षा जांच को नियमित राज्य स्वच्छता सर्वेक्षणों में शामिल करने का एक प्रयास राज्यों और उद्योग समूहों की कानूनी चुनौतियों के बाद वापस ले लिया गया।

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: परिणाम एक ऐसा क्षेत्र है जहाँ अच्छे अभ्यास को दृढ़ता से प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है, व्यापक रूप से प्रकाशित किया जाता है, और असमान रूप से अपनाया जाता है।

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: संघीय साइबर और पर्यावरण एजेंसियों ने, जल क्षेत्र के अपने सूचना-साझाकरण संगठन के साथ मिलकर, उपयोगिताओं को मार्गदर्शन और मुफ्त मूल्यांकन सेवाएं प्रदान की हैं।

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: तत्काल मांगें साधारण और विशिष्ट हैं: कंट्रोल इंटरफेस को खुले इंटरनेट से हटाएँ, डिफॉल्ट क्रेडेंशियल्स को बदलें, रिमोट एक्सेस के लिए मल्टीफैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन चालू करें, कंट्रोलर कॉन्फ़िगरेशन के ऑफ़लाइन बैकअप रखें, और सुनिश्चित करें कि किसी को पता हो कि रात 3 बजे किसे कॉल करना है।

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: इनमें से कोई भी सलाह नई नहीं है।

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: जो नया हो सकता है वह राजनीतिक ध्यान है।

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: एक अकेली घटना एक हेडलाइन है; सात राज्यों में दर्जनों उपयोगिताएँ एक पैटर्न है, और पैटर्न ही बजट को बदलते हैं।

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: निवासियों के लिए, कोई कार्रवाई करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है और आपके पानी के उपयोग के तरीके को बदलने का कोई कारण नहीं है।

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: स्थानीय उपयोगिताओं को ग्राहकों को सूचित करना आवश्यक है यदि पीने का पानी कभी सुरक्षा मानकों को पूरा नहीं करता है, और आपकी वार्षिक जल गुणवत्ता रिपोर्ट वह दस्तावेज़ बनी हुई है जो वास्तव में आपको बताती है कि आप क्या पी रहे हैं।

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: यदि आप जानना चाहते हैं कि आपकी अपनी प्रणाली कैसी चल रही है, तो वह रिपोर्ट — और उपयोगिता के बोर्ड मीटिंग, जो सार्वजनिक हैं — वह जगह है जहाँ देखना चाहिए।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: किसी ने किसी के पानी में जहर नहीं मिलाया।

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: इसे स्पष्ट रूप से कहा जाना चाहिए, क्योंकि वैकल्पिक फ्रेमिंग तेजी से फैलती है और किसी की मदद नहीं करती।

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: जो हुआ वह यह है कि बहुत से लोगों ने खोजा कि कितने सामने के दरवाजे हैं, और उनमें से कितने खुले थे।

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: वे बचाव जिन्होंने इसे सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य घटना में बदलने से रोका, काफी हद तक पुराने थे — भौतिक सीमाएँ, रसायन विज्ञान, गेज देखने वाले प्रशिक्षित ऑपरेटर।

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: वे अच्छे बचाव हैं।

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: वे अंतिम पंक्ति हैं, पहली नहीं।

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: यह प्रकरण यह सवाल छोड़ जाता है कि क्या देश 50,000 अलग-अलग पतों पर पहली पंक्ति के लिए भुगतान करने को तैयार है।

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: अब तक, वह उत्तर प्रत्येक के लिए व्यक्तिगत रूप से छोड़ दिया गया है।

es.title: Alguien está llamando a la puerta del suministro de agua de Estados Unidos: Hackers atacan servicios públicos en siete estados

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: Investigadores federales están examinando un grupo de intrusiones informáticas en sistemas de agua municipales distribuidos en al menos siete estados, según funcionarios y agencias estatales que han confirmado casos en los últimos días.

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: Las autoridades de Michigan han dicho que nueve servicios públicos en el estado se vieron afectados.

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: El recuento de Minnesota es mayor: más de treinta sistemas marcados para revisión.

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: El mensaje de los funcionarios hasta ahora ha sido consistente en un punto: no se sabe que el agua potable haya sido alterada, y no hay indicios de que el grifo de alguien sea inseguro.

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: Pero los incidentes han descorrido el telón sobre algo que los profesionales del agua han estado diciendo discretamente durante años.

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos no tiene *un* sistema de agua.

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: Tiene decenas de miles de ellos, la mayoría pequeños, la mayoría gestionados localmente, y muchos de ellos defendidos por un presupuesto que no cubriría el departamento de TI de una empresa mediana.

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *Esta es una historia en desarrollo.

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: Los detalles reportados por las agencias estatales y federales pueden cambiar a medida que las investigaciones continúen.*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## Lo que han descrito los funcionarios

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: La actividad llamó la atención general después de que un aviso federal advirtiera que los intrusos estaban intentando llegar al lado operativo de los servicios de agua, no a los servidores de facturación o las cuentas de correo electrónico, sino a los sistemas que realmente abren válvulas, accionan bombas y dosifican productos químicos.

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: Las agencias estatales de medio ambiente y seguridad pública comenzaron entonces a contactar a los servicios públicos dentro de sus fronteras para revisar registros y equipos.

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: El departamento de medio ambiente de Michigan confirmó nueve sistemas afectados.

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de Minnesota describieron una revisión más amplia que afectó a más de treinta.

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: Otros estados han reconocido casos sin publicar recuentos, y los investigadores federales están tratando los incidentes como parte de un patrón en lugar de una serie de coincidencias.

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios generalmente se han negado a nombrar a los servicios públicos individuales, lo cual es una práctica estándar mientras una investigación está abierta.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: Publicar una lista de sistemas con debilidades conocidas no es, por razones obvias, algo que las agencias se apresuren a hacer.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: Lo que se ha dicho públicamente es limitado y conviene leerlo literalmente: ningún cambio confirmado en la calidad del agua, ningún daño confirmado a ningún cliente y ninguna interrupción confirmada del servicio.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: Eso no es lo mismo que decir que no pasó nada.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: Significa que las consecuencias no llegaron al agua.

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## La parte de un servicio público en la que la mayoría de la gente nunca piensa

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: Cada sistema de agua funciona con dos mundos tecnológicos separados.

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: El primero es la TI de oficina ordinaria: correo electrónico, facturación, nóminas, el portal del cliente donde paga su factura.

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: El segundo es la **tecnología operativa**, u OT: el equipo de control industrial que físicamente hace funcionar la planta.

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: Los sensores informan el nivel de un tanque.

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: Un controlador decide que una bomba debe arrancar.

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: Una pantalla en la sala de control muestra al operador lo que la planta está haciendo y le permite ajustarlo.

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: Ese segundo mundo fue diseñado, en la mayoría de los casos, hace décadas, para una época en la que la única forma de llegar a un panel de control era acercarse a él.

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: Su prioridad era el tiempo de actividad y la previsibilidad, no la autenticación.

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: Luego, gradualmente y por razones perfectamente sensatas, partes de él se conectaron, para que un técnico pudiera revisar una estación de bombeo remota a las 2 a.m.

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: sin tener que conducir cuarenta millas, para que un proveedor pudiera lanzar una actualización de firmware, para que un pequeño servicio público con tres empleados pudiera cubrir un área de servicio del tamaño de un condado.

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: Cada una de esas conveniencias es también una puerta.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: Las intrusiones bajo investigación parecen haber involucrado esa categoría de puerta: interfaces de control accesibles remotamente, protegidas por lo que sea que el servicio público tuviera tiempo y dinero para poner delante de ellas.

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: Los investigadores de seguridad han estado señalando esta exposición específica durante mucho tiempo.

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: Las herramientas de escaneo que catalogan dispositivos conectados a internet encuentran rutinariamente interfaces de control industrial abiertas al público.

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: Algunas de ellas pertenecen a sistemas de agua.

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: No hace falta un presupuesto de estado-nación para encontrarlas, lo que es parte de lo que hace que el riesgo sea tan persistente.

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## Por qué el agua sigue siendo casi con certeza segura

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: Es razonable querer una respuesta más fuerte que "los funcionarios dicen que es seguro".

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: Aquí está la razón estructural por la cual la reafirmación es creíble.

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: El tratamiento del agua se basa en la **redundancia**, y fue construido así mucho antes de que alguien se preocupara por los hackers.

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: Fue construido así porque el equipo falla y la gente comete errores.

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **Límites físicos.** Los sistemas de alimentación química suelen estar dimensionados para que una bomba funcionando al máximo no pueda entregar una dosis salvajemente fuera de rango.

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **Monitoreo continuo.** El agua tratada se prueba constantemente —cloro residual, turbidez, pH— mediante instrumentos que dan la alarma cuando las lecturas varían, y mediante muestras de laboratorio posteriores.

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **Operadores humanos.** Operadores certificados vigilan la planta. Una pantalla de control que muestra un comando implausible es exactamente el tipo de cosa que están entrenados para detectar y anular.

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **Control manual.** Casi todas las funciones automatizadas tienen un respaldo físico local. Los operadores pueden y suelen operar las plantas manualmente.

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **Tiempo.** El agua no viaja instantáneamente desde el tratamiento hasta el grifo. Se mueve a través del almacenamiento y la distribución, lo que añade horas de amortiguación y dilución.

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: Al sumar todo esto, la imagen se vuelve más clara: llegar a una interfaz de control es una brecha grave del perímetro de un servicio público, pero no es lo mismo que controlar lo que sale de su grifo.

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: En los casos conocidos públicamente de este tipo en los últimos años, esa brecha se ha mantenido.

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## La vulnerabilidad real es aritmética

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: La parte incómoda de esta historia no es ninguna intrusión individual.

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: Es la escala del área de superficie.

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: Hay aproximadamente 50,000 sistemas de agua comunitarios en el país.

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: La gran mayoría —algo así como nueve de cada diez— sirven a menos de 10,000 personas.

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: Se trata de pueblos, distritos escolares, parques de casas móviles, cooperativas rurales.

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: Un sistema que sirve a 2,000 residentes podría emplear a un puñado de personas en total, todas enfocadas en asegurarse de que el agua esté limpia y la presión se mantenga.

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: Pedir a ese servicio público que también mantenga la segmentación de red, la autenticación multifactor, el software de acceso remoto parcheado, el registro de eventos y un plan de respuesta a incidentes, es pedir una experiencia que no existe en el personal y un dinero que no existe en la base de tarifas.

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: Subir las tarifas del agua para financiar la ciberseguridad es difícil de vender en cualquier reunión municipal.

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: La regulación también ha tenido dificultades con esto.

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: La ley federal exige que los sistemas más grandes —aquellos que sirven a más de 3,300 personas— realicen evaluaciones de riesgo y resiliencia que incluyan la ciberseguridad, pero ese requisito es periódico y autodirigido.

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: Un intento en 2023 de integrar los controles de ciberseguridad en las encuestas sanitarias estatales rutinarias fue retirado tras impugnaciones legales de estados y grupos industriales.

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: El resultado es un sector donde las buenas prácticas son fuertemente alentadas, ampliamente publicadas y adoptadas de manera desigual.

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## Qué pasará a continuación

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: Las agencias federales de ciberseguridad y medio ambiente, junto con la organización de intercambio de información del propio sector del agua, han emitido guías y servicios de evaluación gratuitos para los servicios públicos.

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: Las peticiones inmediatas son poco glamurosas y específicas: sacar las interfaces de control de la internet abierta, reemplazar las credenciales predeterminadas, activar la autenticación multifactor para el acceso remoto, mantener copias de seguridad fuera de línea de las configuraciones del controlador y asegurarse de que alguien sepa a quién llamar a las 3 a.m.

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: Nada de eso es un consejo nuevo.

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: Lo que puede ser nuevo es la atención política.

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: Un solo incidente es un titular; docenas de servicios públicos en siete estados es un patrón, y los patrones son lo que mueven los presupuestos.

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: Para los residentes, no hay ninguna acción que tomar y no hay razón para cambiar nada sobre cómo usan su agua.

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: Los servicios públicos locales están obligados a notificar a los clientes si el agua potable deja de cumplir los estándares de seguridad, y su informe anual de calidad del agua sigue siendo el documento que realmente le informa sobre lo que está bebiendo.

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: Si quiere saber cómo está su propio sistema, ese informe —y las reuniones de la junta del servicio público, que son públicas— es donde debe mirar.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: Nadie envenenó el agua de nadie.

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: Eso merece ser dicho claramente, porque el marco alternativo se propaga rápido y no ayuda a nadie.

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: Lo que sí sucedió es que mucha gente descubrió cuántas puertas delanteras hay y cuántas de ellas estaban sin llave.

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: Las defensas que evitaron que esto se convirtiera en un evento de salud pública fueron en gran medida las antiguas: límites físicos, química, operadores capacitados vigilando los medidores.

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: Esas son buenas defensas.

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: También son la última línea, no la primera.

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: La pregunta que deja este episodio es si el país está dispuesto a pagar por una primera línea en 50,000 direcciones separadas.

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: Hasta ahora, esa respuesta ha quedado en manos de cada uno de ellos individualmente.

ar.title: شخص ما يطرق أبواب إمدادات المياه في أمريكا: القراصنة يضربون المرافق في سبع ولايات

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: يتحقق المحققون الفيدراليون من مجموعة من عمليات التسلل الحاسوبية إلى أنظمة المياه البلدية المنتشرة في سبع ولايات على الأقل، وفقاً لمسؤولين ووكالات حكومية أكدت الحالات في الأيام الأخيرة.

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: وقالت السلطات في ميشيغان إن تسع مرافق في الولاية قد تضررت.

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: أما في مينيسوتا، فالعدد أكبر - أكثر من ثلاثين نظاماً تم تحديدها للمراجعة.

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: كانت رسالة المسؤولين حتى الآن متسقة في نقطة واحدة: لا يُعرف أن مياه الشرب نفسها قد تغيرت، ولا يوجد ما يشير إلى أن صنبور أي شخص غير آمن.

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: لكن هذه الحوادث كشفت الستار عن شيء كان متخصصو المياه يقولونه بهدوء لسنوات.

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: الولايات المتحدة ليس لديها *نظام* مياه واحد.

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: بل لديها عشرات الآلاف منها، معظمها صغير، ومعظمها يدار محلياً، والعديد منها محمي بميزانية لا تغطي حتى قسم تكنولوجيا المعلومات في شركة متوسطة الحجم.

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *هذه قصة في طور التطور.

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: وقد تتغير التفاصيل التي أبلغت عنها الوكالات الحكومية والفيدرالية مع استمرار التحقيقات.*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## ما وصفه المسؤولون

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: جذبت هذه الأنشطة اهتماماً أوسع بعد أن حذر استشارة فيدرالية من أن المتسللين يحاولون الوصول إلى الجانب التشغيلي لمرافق المياه - ليس خوادم الفواتير أو حسابات البريد الإلكتروني، بل الأنظمة التي تفتح الصمامات فعلياً، وتشغل المضخات، وتضيف المواد الكيميائية.

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: ثم بدأت وكالات البيئة والسلامة العامة في الولايات في الاتصال بالمرافق داخل حدودها للتحقق من السجلات والمعدات.

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: وأكدت وزارة البيئة في ميشيغان تضرر تسعة أنظمة.

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: ووصف المسؤولون في مينيسوتا مراجعة أوسع شملت أكثر من ثلاثين نظاماً.

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: واعترفت ولايات أخرى بوجود حالات دون نشر الأعداد، ويتعامل المحققون الفيدراليون مع هذه الحوادث كجزء من نمط واحد بدلاً من كونها سلسلة من المصادفات.

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: ورفض المسؤولون عموماً تسمية مرافق بعينها، وهو إجراء قياسي بينما لا يزال التحقيق مفتوحاً.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: إن نشر قائمة بالأنظمة التي تعاني من نقاط ضعف معروفة ليس، لأسباب واضحة، أمراً تسارع الوكالات للقيام به.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: ما قيل علناً كان محدداً ويجب قراءته حرفياً: لا يوجد تغيير مؤكد في جودة المياه، ولا ضرر مؤكد لأي عميل، ولا انقطاع مؤكد في الخدمة.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: وهذا لا يعني أن شيئاً لم يحدث.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: بل يعني أن العواقب لم تصل إلى المياه.

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## الجزء من المرفق الذي لا يفكر فيه معظم الناس

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: يعمل كل نظام مياه على عالمين منفصلين من التكنولوجيا.

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: الأول هو تكنولوجيا المعلومات المكتبية العادية - البريد الإلكتروني، الفواتير، كشوف المرتبات، وبوابة العملاء حيث تدفع فاتورتك.

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: والثاني هو **التكنولوجيا التشغيلية**، أو OT: معدات التحكم الصناعية التي تدير المحطة فعلياً.

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: تقوم المستشعرات بالإبلاغ عن مستوى الخزان.

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: ويقرر جهاز التحكم في بدء تشغيل المضخة.

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: وتظهر شاشة في غرفة التحكم للمشغل ما تفعله المحطة وتسمح له بتعديله.

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: تم تصميم هذا العالم الثاني، في معظم الحالات، منذ عقود، لوقت كان فيه السبيل الوحيد للوصول إلى لوحة التحكم هو السير نحوها.

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: كانت أولويته هي وقت التشغيل والقدرة على التنبؤ، وليس المصادقة.

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: ثم، تدريجياً ولأسباب منطقية تماماً، تم توصيل أجزاء منه - حتى يتمكن الفني من فحص محطة مضخات عن بعد في الساعة 2 صباحاً.

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: دون الحاجة للقيادة لمسافة أربعين ميلاً، وحتى يتمكن المورد من إرسال تحديث للبرامج الثابتة، وحتى تتمكن مرفق صغير يضم ثلاثة موظفين من تغطية منطقة خدمة بحجم مقاطعة.

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: كل واحدة من هذه التسهيلات هي أيضاً باب.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: يبدو أن عمليات التسلل قيد التحقيق شملت هذه الفئة من الأبواب: واجهات التحكم التي يمكن الوصول إليها عن بعد، والمحمية بما كان لدى المرفق من وقت ومال لوضعه أمامها.

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: يشير الباحثون الأمنيون إلى هذا التعرض المحدد منذ فترة طويلة.

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: أدوات المسح التي تفهرس الأجهزة المتصلة بالإنترنت تكتشف بشكل روتيني واجهات تحكم صناعية متاحة للعامة.

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: بعضها ينتمي إلى أنظمة المياه.

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: لا يتطلب الأمر ميزانية دولة للعثور عليها - وهذا جزء مما يجعل المخاطر مستعصية للغاية.

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا تزال المياه على الأرجح سليمة

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: من المعقول الرغبة في الحصول على إجابة أقوى من "يقول المسؤولون إنها آمنة".

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: إليك السبب الهيكلي الذي يجعل هذا التطمين موثوقاً.

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: تعتمد معالجة المياه على **التكرار (Redundancy)**، وقد بُنيت بهذه الطريقة قبل وقت طويل من قلق أي شخص بشأن القراصنة.

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: لقد بُنيت بهذه الطريقة لأن المعدات تتعطل والناس يرتكبون الأخطاء.

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **الحدود الفيزيائية.** عادة ما يتم تحديد حجم أنظمة التغذية الكيميائية بحيث لا يمكن للمضخة التي تعمل بأقصى طاقتها أن تقدم جرعة خارج النطاق بشكل صارخ. لا يمكنك إجبار المحطة على فعل شيء لا يمكن للسباكة القيام به فيزيائياً.

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **المراقبة المستمرة.** يتم اختبار المياه المعالجة باستمرار - لبقايا الكلور، والعكارة، والرقم الهيدروجيني (pH) - بواسطة أجهزة تطلق إنذاراً عندما تنحرف القراءات، وبواسطة عينات مخبرية تتبع ذلك.

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
