segments.tr: - **المشغلون البشريون.** يراقب المشغلون المعتمدون المحطة. شاشة التحكم التي تظهر أمراً غير منطقي هي بالضبط نوع الشيء الذي تدربوا على رصده وتجاوزه.

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **التحكم اليدوي.** لكل وظيفة مؤتمتة تقريباً بديل محلي مادي. يمكن للمشغلين تشغيل المحطات يدوياً وهم يفعلون ذلك بالفعل.

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **الوقت.** لا تنتقل المياه فوراً من المعالجة إلى الصنبور. فهي تتحرك عبر التخزين والتوزيع، مما يضيف ساعات من التخزين المؤقت والتخفيف.

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: عند دمج هذه الطبقات معاً، تصبح الصورة أوضح: الوصول إلى واجهة التحكم هو خرق خطير لمحيط المرفق، لكنه ليس هو نفسه التحكم فيما يخرج من صنبورك.

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: في الحالات المعروفة علناً من هذا النوع على مدى السنوات القليلة الماضية، صمدت هذه الفجوة.

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## الضعف الحقيقي هو حسابي

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: الجزء المزعج من هذه القصة ليس أي عملية تسلل واحدة.

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: بل هو حجم مساحة السطح المعرضة للخطر.

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: هناك ما يقرب من 50,000 نظام مياه مجتمعي في البلاد.

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: الغالبية العظمى - حوالي تسعة من كل عشرة - تخدم أقل من 10,000 شخص.

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: هذه قرى، ومناطق مدرسية، ومجمعات منازل متنقلة، وتعاونيات ريفية.

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: النظام الذي يخدم 2,000 ساكن قد يوظف عدداً قليلاً من الأشخاص في المجمل، وجميعهم يركزون على ضمان نظافة المياه والحفاظ على الضغط.

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: إذا طلبت من هذا المرفق أن يقوم أيضاً بصيانة تقسيم الشبكة، والمصادقة متعددة العوامل، وبرامج الوصول عن بعد المحدثة، وتسجيل السجلات، وخطة الاستجابة للحوادث، فإنك تطلب خبرة غير موجودة لدى الموظفين وأموالاً غير موجودة في قاعدة الأسعار.

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: إن رفع أسعار المياه لتمويل الأمن السيبراني أمر يصعب تسويقه في أي اجتماع للبلدة.

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: لقد عانت التنظيمات من هذا أيضاً.

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: يتطلب القانون الفيدرالي من الأنظمة الأكبر - تلك التي تخدم أكثر من 3,300 شخص - إجراء تقييمات للمخاطر والمرونة تشمل الأمن السيبراني، لكن هذا المتطلب دوري وموجه ذاتياً.

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: تم سحب محاولة في عام 2023 لدمج فحوصات الأمن السيبراني في المسوحات الصحية الحكومية الروتينية بعد تحديات قانونية من الولايات ومجموعات الصناعة.

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: والنتيجة هي قطاع يتم فيه تشجيع الممارسات الجيدة بقوة، ونشرها على نطاق واسع، ولكن يتم تبنيها بشكل غير متكافئ.

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: قامت الوكالات السيبرانية والبيئية الفيدرالية، جنباً إلى جنب مع منظمة تبادل المعلومات الخاصة بقطاع المياه، بتقديم إرشادات وخدمات تقييم مجانية للمرافق.

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: المطالب الفورية غير مبهرة ومحددة: إخراج واجهات التحكم من الإنترنت المفتوح، استبدال بيانات الاعتماد الافتراضية، تفعيل المصادقة متعددة العوامل للوصول عن بعد، الاحتفاظ بنسخ احتياطية غير متصلة بالإنترنت لتكوينات أجهزة التحكم، والتأكد من أن شخصاً ما يعرف من يتصل به في الساعة 3 صباحاً.

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: لا شيء من هذا يمثل نصيحة جديدة.

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: ما قد يكون جديداً هو الاهتمام السياسي.

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: حادثة واحدة هي مجرد عنوان رئيسي؛ أما عشرات المرافق عبر سبع ولايات فهي نمط، والأنماط هي التي تحرك الميزانيات.

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للسكان، لا يوجد إجراء يجب اتخاذه ولا سبب لتغيير أي شيء في كيفية استخدام المياه.

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: تلتزم المرافق المحلية بإخطار العملاء إذا فشلت مياه الشرب في أي وقت في تلبية معايير السلامة، ويظل تقرير جودة المياه السنوي هو الوثيقة التي تخبرك فعلياً بما تشربه.

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تريد معرفة كيف يسير نظامك الخاص، فإن هذا التقرير - واجتماعات مجلس إدارة المرفق، والتي تكون عامة - هو المكان الذي يجب أن تبحث فيه.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: لم يقم أحد بتسميم مياه أي شخص.

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: يستحق هذا أن يقال بوضوح، لأن الصياغة البديلة تنتشر بسرعة ولا تساعد أحداً.

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: ما حدث هو أن الكثير من الناس اكتشفوا عدد الأبواب الأمامية الموجودة، وكم منها كان غير مقفل.

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: الدفاعات التي منعت هذا من أن يصبح حدثاً يمس الصحة العامة كانت إلى حد كبير الدفاعات القديمة - الحدود الفيزيائية، الكيمياء، والمشغلون المدربون الذين يراقبون المقاييس.

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: هذه دفاعات جيدة.

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: لكنها أيضاً خط الدفاع الأخير، وليست الأول.

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: السؤال الذي تتركه هذه الحلقة هو ما إذا كانت البلاد مستعدة للدفع مقابل خط دفاع أول في 50,000 عنوان منفصل.

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: حتى الآن، تُرِك هذا الجواب لكل واحد منهم على حدة.

fr.title: Quelqu'un frappe à la porte de l'approvisionnement en eau des États-Unis : des pirates s'en prennent aux services publics de sept États

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs fédéraux examinent un groupe d'intrusions informatiques dans des systèmes d'eau municipaux répartis dans au moins sept États, selon des responsables et des agences d'État qui ont confirmé des cas ces derniers jours.

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: Les autorités du Michigan ont déclaré que neuf services publics de l'État ont été touchés.

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: Le décompte du Minnesota est plus élevé — plus de trente systèmes ont été signalés pour examen.

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: Le message des responsables jusqu'à présent a été constant sur un point : on ne sait pas si l'eau potable elle-même a été altérée, et rien n'indique que le robinet de quelqu'un soit dangereux.

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: Mais les incidents ont levé le rideau sur quelque chose que les professionnels de l'eau disent discrètement depuis des années.

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis n'ont pas *un* système d'eau.

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: Ils en ont des dizaines de milliers, la plupart petits, la plupart gérés localement, et beaucoup d'entre eux défendus par un budget qui ne couvrirait pas le département informatique d'une entreprise de taille moyenne.

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *Ceci est une histoire en cours d'évolution.

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: Les détails rapportés par les agences d'État et fédérales peuvent changer à mesure que les enquêtes se poursuivent.*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## Ce que les responsables ont décrit

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: L'activité a attiré une attention plus large après qu'un avis fédéral a averti que des intrus tentaient d'atteindre le côté opérationnel des services d'eau — non pas les serveurs de facturation ou les comptes de messagerie, mais les systèmes qui ouvrent réellement les vannes, font fonctionner les pompes et dosent les produits chimiques.

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: Les agences d'environnement et de sécurité publique des États ont alors commencé à contacter les services publics dans leurs limites pour vérifier les journaux et l'équipement.

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: Le département de l'environnement du Michigan a confirmé neuf systèmes touchés.

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: Les responsables du Minnesota ont décrit un examen plus large touchant plus de trente systèmes.

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: D'autres États ont reconnu des cas sans publier de chiffres, et les enquêteurs fédéraux traitent les incidents comme faisant partie d'un seul schéma plutôt que d'une série de coïncidences.

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: Les responsables ont généralement refusé de nommer les services publics individuels, ce qui est la pratique standard tant qu'une enquête est ouverte.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: Publier une liste de systèmes présentant des faiblesses connues n'est pas, pour des raisons évidentes, quelque chose que les agences s'empressent de faire.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: Ce qui a été dit publiquement est restreint et mérite d'être lu littéralement : aucun changement confirmé de la qualité de l'eau, aucun dommage confirmé pour tout client, et aucune interruption de service confirmée.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas la même chose que de dire que rien ne s'est passé.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que les conséquences n'ont pas atteint l'eau.

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## La partie d'un service public à laquelle la plupart des gens ne pensent jamais

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: Chaque système d'eau fonctionne sur deux mondes technologiques distincts.

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: Le premier est l'informatique de bureau ordinaire — e-mail, facturation, paie, le portail client où vous payez votre facture.

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: Le second est la **technologie opérationnelle**, ou OT : l'équipement de contrôle industriel qui fait fonctionner physiquement l'usine.

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: Des capteurs signalent le niveau d'un réservoir.

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: Un contrôleur décide qu'une pompe doit démarrer.

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: Un écran dans la salle de contrôle montre à l'opérateur ce que l'usine fait et lui permet de l'ajuster.

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: Ce second monde a été conçu, dans la plupart des cas, il y a des décennies, pour une époque où le seul moyen d'atteindre un panneau de contrôle était de s'en approcher physiquement.

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: Sa priorité était la disponibilité et la prévisibilité, pas l'authentification.

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: Ensuite, progressivement et pour des raisons parfaitement sensées, des parties de celui-ci ont été connectées — pour qu'un technicien puisse vérifier une station de pompage distante à 2 heures du matin

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: sans avoir à conduire quarante milles, pour qu'un fournisseur puisse pousser une mise à jour du firmware, pour qu'un petit service public avec trois employés puisse couvrir une zone de service de la taille d'un comté.

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: Chacune de ces commodités est également une porte.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: Les intrusions sous enquête semblent avoir impliqué cette catégorie de porte : des interfaces de contrôle accessibles à distance, protégées par tout ce que le service public avait le temps et l'argent de mettre devant elles.

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: Les chercheurs en sécurité signalent cette exposition spécifique depuis longtemps.

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: Les outils de scan qui cataloguent les appareils connectés à Internet font régulièrement apparaître des interfaces de contrôle industriel laissées ouvertes.

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: Certaines d'entre elles appartiennent à des systèmes d'eau.

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: Il ne faut pas le budget d'un État-nation pour les trouver — ce qui fait partie de ce qui rend le risque si tenace.

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'eau est encore presque certainement correcte

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: Il est raisonnable de vouloir une réponse plus forte que « les responsables disent que c'est sûr ».

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: Voici la raison structurelle pour laquelle l'assurance est crédible.

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: Le traitement de l'eau est basé sur la **redondance**, et il a été conçu ainsi bien avant que quiconque ne s'inquiète des pirates.

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: Il a été conçu ainsi parce que l'équipement tombe en panne et que les gens font des erreurs.

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **Limites physiques.** Les systèmes d'alimentation chimique sont généralement dimensionnés de sorte qu'une pompe fonctionnant au maximum ne puisse toujours pas délivrer une dose largement hors norme. Vous ne pouvez pas forcer l'usine à faire quelque chose que la plomberie ne peut physiquement pas faire.

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **Surveillance continue.** L'eau traitée est testée constamment — pour le chlore résiduel, la turbidité, le pH — par des instruments qui alertent lorsque les lectures dérivent, et par des échantillons de laboratoire qui suivent.

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **Opérateurs humains.** Des opérateurs certifiés surveillent l'usine. Un écran de contrôle affichant une commande improbable est exactement le genre de chose qu'ils sont formés à détecter et à annuler.

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **Contrôle manuel.** Presque chaque fonction automatisée a un repli physique local. Les opérateurs peuvent et font fonctionner les usines manuellement.

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **Temps.** L'eau ne voyage pas instantanément du traitement au robinet. Elle passe par le stockage et la distribution, ce qui ajoute des heures de tampon et de dilution.

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: En superposant ces éléments, le tableau devient plus clair : atteindre une interface de contrôle est une violation grave du périmètre d'un service public, mais ce n'est pas la même chose que de contrôler ce qui sort de votre robinet.

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: Dans les cas publiquement connus de ce genre au cours des dernières années, cet écart a tenu.

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## La véritable vulnérabilité est arithmétique

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: La partie inconfortable de cette histoire n'est pas une intrusion unique.

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: C'est l'échelle de la surface d'attaque.

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: Il y a environ 50 000 systèmes d'eau communautaires dans le pays.

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: L'immense majorité — environ neuf sur dix — servent moins de 10 000 personnes.

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: Ce sont des villages, des districts scolaires, des parcs de maisons mobiles, des coopératives rurales.

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: Un système servant 2 000 résidents peut employer un total de quelques personnes, toutes concentrées sur le fait de s'assurer que l'eau est propre et que la pression se maintient.

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: Demander à ce service public de maintenir également une segmentation réseau, une authentification multifactorielle, des logiciels d'accès à distance corrigés, la journalisation et un plan de réponse aux incidents, c'est demander une expertise qui n'existe pas dans le personnel et de l'argent qui n'existe pas dans la base tarifaire.

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: Augmenter les tarifs de l'eau pour financer la cybersécurité est difficile à vendre lors de toute réunion de ville.

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: La réglementation a également eu du mal avec cela.

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: La loi fédérale exige que les systèmes plus importants — ceux servant plus de 3 300 personnes — effectuent des évaluations de risque et de résilience qui incluent la cybersécurité, mais cette exigence est périodique et autodirigée.

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: Une tentative en 2023 d'intégrer les contrôles de cybersécurité dans les enquêtes sanitaires d'État de routine a été retirée après des contestations juridiques de la part d'États et de groupes industriels.

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: Le résultat est un secteur où les bonnes pratiques sont fortement encouragées, largement publiées et adoptées de manière inégale.

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## Ce qui se passe ensuite

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: Les agences fédérales de cybersécurité et d'environnement, ainsi que l'organisation de partage d'informations du secteur de l'eau, ont diffusé des directives et des services d'évaluation gratuits aux services publics.

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: Les demandes immédiates sont sans éclat et spécifiques : retirer les interfaces de contrôle de l'Internet ouvert, remplacer les identifiants par défaut, activer l'authentification multifactorielle pour l'accès à distance, conserver des sauvegardes hors ligne des configurations de contrôleur et s'assurer que quelqu'un sait qui appeler à 3 heures du matin.

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela n'est un nouveau conseil.

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: Ce qui peut être nouveau, c'est l'attention politique.

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: Un seul incident est un titre ; des dizaines de services publics dans sept États sont un schéma, et les schémas sont ce qui fait bouger les budgets.

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: Pour les résidents, il n'y a aucune action à entreprendre et aucune raison de changer quoi que ce soit à la façon dont vous utilisez votre eau.

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: Les services publics locaux sont tenus d'informer les clients si l'eau potable ne respecte plus les normes de sécurité, et votre rapport annuel sur la qualité de l'eau reste le document qui vous informe réellement sur ce que vous buvez.

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: Si vous voulez savoir comment se porte votre propre système, ce rapport — et les réunions du conseil d'administration du service public, qui sont publiques — sont les endroits où regarder.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: Personne n'a empoisonné l'eau de qui que ce soit.

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: Cela mérite d'être dit clairement, car l'alternative se propage rapidement et n'aide personne.

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: Ce qui s'est passé, c'est que beaucoup de gens ont découvert combien il y a de portes d'entrée et combien d'entre elles étaient déverrouillées.

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: Les défenses qui ont empêché cela de devenir un événement de santé publique étaient largement les anciennes — limites physiques, chimie, opérateurs formés surveillant les jauges.

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: Ce sont de bonnes défenses.

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: Elles sont également la dernière ligne, pas la première.

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: La question que cet épisode laisse derrière lui est de savoir si le pays est prêt à payer pour une première ligne à 50 000 adresses distinctes.

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à présent, cette réponse a été laissée à chacun d'entre eux individuellement.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: Publicar uma lista de sistemas com fraquezas conhecidas não é, por razões óbvias, algo que as agências se apressem a fazer.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: O que foi dito publicamente é restrito e deve ser lido literalmente: nenhuma alteração confirmada na qualidade da água, nenhum dano confirmado a qualquer cliente e nenhuma interrupção de serviço confirmada.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: Isso não é o mesmo que dizer que nada aconteceu.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: Significa que as consequências não chegaram à água.

segments.src: ## The part of a utility most people never think about
segments.tr: ## A parte de uma concessionária que a maioria das pessoas nunca pensa

segments.src: Every water system runs on two separate worlds of technology.
segments.tr: Todo sistema de água opera com dois mundos separados de tecnologia.

segments.src: The first is ordinary office IT — email, billing, payroll, the customer portal where you pay your bill.
segments.tr: O primeiro é a TI de escritório comum — e-mail, faturamento, folha de pagamento, o portal do cliente onde você paga sua conta.

segments.src: The second is **operational technology**, or OT: the industrial control equipment that physically runs the plant.
segments.tr: O segundo é a **tecnologia operacional**, ou OT: o equipamento de controle industrial que fisicamente opera a planta.

segments.src: Sensors report a tank level.
segments.tr: Sensores relatam o nível de um tanque.

segments.src: A controller decides a pump should start.
segments.tr: Um controlador decide que uma bomba deve começar.

segments.src: A screen in the control room shows an operator what the plant is doing and lets them adjust it.
segments.tr: Uma tela na sala de controle mostra ao operador o que a planta está fazendo e permite que ele a ajuste.

segments.src: That second world was designed, in most cases, decades ago, for a time when the only way to reach a control panel was to walk up to it.
segments.tr: Esse segundo mundo foi projetado, na maioria dos casos, décadas atrás, para uma época em que a única maneira de alcançar um painel de controle era caminhar até ele.

segments.src: Its priority was uptime and predictability, not authentication.
segments.tr: Sua prioridade era o tempo de atividade e a previsibilidade, não a autenticação.

segments.src: Then, gradually and for perfectly sensible reasons, pieces of it got connected — so a technician could check a remote pump station at 2 a.m.
segments.tr: Então, gradualmente e por razões perfeitamente sensatas, partes dele foram conectadas — para que um técnico pudesse verificar uma estação de bombeamento remota às 2 da manhã

segments.src: without driving forty miles, so a vendor could push a firmware update, so a small utility with three employees could cover a service area the size of a county.
segments.tr: sem ter que dirigir quarenta milhas, para que um fornecedor pudesse enviar uma atualização de firmware, para que uma pequena concessionária com três funcionários pudesse cobrir uma área de serviço do tamanho de um condado.

segments.src: Each of those conveniences is also a door.
segments.tr: Cada uma dessas conveniências é também uma porta.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: As intrusões sob investigação parecem ter envolvido essa categoria de porta: interfaces de controle acessíveis remotamente, protegidas por qualquer coisa que a concessionária teve tempo e dinheiro para colocar na frente delas.

segments.src: Security researchers have been pointing at this specific exposure for a long time.
segments.tr: Pesquisadores de segurança vêm apontando para essa exposição específica há muito tempo.

segments.src: Scanning tools that catalog internet-connected devices routinely turn up industrial control interfaces sitting in the open.
segments.tr: Ferramentas de varredura que catalogam dispositivos conectados à internet rotineiramente encontram interfaces de controle industrial abertas.

segments.src: Some of them belong to water systems.
segments.tr: Algumas delas pertencem a sistemas de água.

segments.src: It does not take a nation-state budget to find them — which is part of what makes the risk so stubborn.
segments.tr: Não é necessário um orçamento de estado-nação para encontrá-las — o que é parte do que torna o risco tão persistente.

segments.src: ## Why the water is still almost certainly fine
segments.tr: ## Por que a água ainda é quase certamente segura

segments.src: It is reasonable to want a stronger answer than "officials say it's safe."
segments.tr: É razoável querer uma resposta mais forte do que "as autoridades dizem que é seguro".

segments.src: Here is the structural reason the reassurance is credible.
segments.tr: Aqui está a razão estrutural pela qual a reafirmação é credível.

segments.src: Water treatment is built on **redundancy**, and it was built that way long before anyone worried about hackers.
segments.tr: O tratamento de água é construído sobre a **redundância**, e foi construído dessa forma muito antes de qualquer pessoa se preocupar com hackers.

segments.src: It was built that way because equipment fails and people make mistakes.
segments.tr: Foi construído dessa forma porque equipamentos falham e pessoas cometem erros.

segments.src: - **Physical limits.** Chemical feed systems are typically sized so that a pump running at maximum still cannot deliver a wildly out-of-range dose. You cannot make the plant do something the plumbing cannot physically do.
segments.tr: - **Limites físicos.** Sistemas de alimentação química são tipicamente dimensionados para que uma bomba operando no máximo ainda não possa entregar uma dose violentamente fora de faixa. Você não pode fazer a planta fazer algo que a tubulação não pode fisicamente fazer.

segments.src: - **Continuous monitoring.** Treated water is tested constantly — for chlorine residual, turbidity, pH — by instruments that alarm when readings drift, and by lab samples that follow.
segments.tr: - **Monitoramento contínuo.** A água tratada é testada constantemente — para resíduo de cloro, turbidez, pH — por instrumentos que disparam alarmes quando as leituras variam, e por amostras de laboratório que se seguem.

segments.src: - **Human operators.** Certified operators watch the plant. A control screen showing an implausible command is exactly the kind of thing they are trained to catch and override.
segments.tr: - **Operadores humanos.** Operadores certificados vigiam a planta. Uma tela de controle mostrando um comando implausível é exatamente o tipo de coisa que eles são treinados para detectar e anular.

segments.src: - **Manual control.** Nearly every automated function has a local, physical fallback. Operators can and do run plants by hand.
segments.tr: - **Controle manual.** Quase toda função automatizada tem um fallback local e físico. Operadores podem e costumam operar plantas manualmente.

segments.src: - **Time.** Water does not travel instantly from treatment to tap. It moves through storage and distribution, which adds hours of buffer and dilution.
segments.tr: - **Tempo.** A água não viaja instantaneamente do tratamento para a torneira. Ela se move através de armazenamento e distribuição, o que adiciona horas de buffer e diluição.

segments.src: Layer those together and the picture becomes clearer: reaching a control interface is a serious breach of a utility's perimeter, but it is not the same as controlling what comes out of your faucet.
segments.tr: Somando essas camadas, a imagem torna-se mais clara: alcançar uma interface de controle é uma violação grave do perímetro de uma concessionária, mas não é o mesmo que controlar o que sai da sua torneira.

segments.src: In the publicly known cases of this kind over the past several years, that gap has held.
segments.tr: Nos casos publicamente conhecidos desse tipo nos últimos anos, essa lacuna se manteve.

segments.src: ## The real vulnerability is arithmetic
segments.tr: ## A vulnerabilidade real é aritmética

segments.src: The uncomfortable part of this story is not any single intrusion.
segments.tr: A parte desconfortável desta história não é qualquer intrusão individual.

segments.src: It is the scale of the surface area.
segments.tr: É a escala da área de superfície.

segments.src: There are roughly 50,000 community water systems in the country.
segments.tr: Existem aproximadamente 50.000 sistemas de água comunitários no país.

segments.src: The overwhelming majority — something like nine in ten — serve fewer than 10,000 people.
segments.tr: A esmagadora maioria — algo como nove em cada dez — atende a menos de 10.000 pessoas.

segments.src: These are villages, school districts, mobile home parks, rural cooperatives.
segments.tr: São vilas, distritos escolares, parques de casas móveis, cooperativas rurais.

segments.src: A system serving 2,000 residents might employ a handful of people total, all of whom are focused on making sure the water is clean and the pressure holds.
segments.tr: Um sistema que atende 2.000 residentes pode empregar um punhado de pessoas no total, todas focadas em garantir que a água esteja limpa e a pressão se mantenha.

segments.src: Ask that utility to also maintain network segmentation, multifactor authentication, patched remote-access software, logging, and an incident response plan, and you are asking for expertise that does not exist on staff and money that does not exist in the rate base.
segments.tr: Pedir que essa concessionária também mantenha a segmentação de rede, autenticação multifator, software de acesso remoto atualizado, logs e um plano de resposta a incidentes é pedir por uma expertise que não existe na equipe e dinheiro que não existe na base tarifária.

segments.src: Raising water rates to fund cybersecurity is a hard sell at any town meeting.
segments.tr: Aumentar as tarifas de água para financiar a cibersegurança é difícil de vender em qualquer reunião de cidade.

segments.src: Regulation has struggled with this too.
segments.tr: A regulamentação também lutou com isso.

segments.src: Federal law requires larger systems — those serving more than 3,300 people — to conduct risk and resilience assessments that include cybersecurity, but that requirement is periodic and self-directed.
segments.tr: A lei federal exige que sistemas maiores — aqueles que atendem a mais de 3.300 pessoas — realizem avaliações de risco e resiliência que incluam a cibersegurança, mas esse requisito é periódico e autodirigido.

segments.src: An attempt in 2023 to fold cybersecurity checks into routine state sanitary surveys was withdrawn after legal challenges from states and industry groups.
segments.tr: Uma tentativa em 2023 de incluir verificações de cibersegurança em levantamentos sanitários estaduais rotineiros foi retirada após contestações legais de estados e grupos da indústria.

segments.src: The result is a sector where good practice is strongly encouraged, widely published, and unevenly adopted.
segments.tr: O resultado é um setor onde a boa prática é fortemente encorajada, amplamente publicada e adotada de forma desigual.

segments.src: ## What happens next
segments.tr: ## O que acontece a seguir

segments.src: Federal cyber and environmental agencies, along with the water sector's own information-sharing organization, have pushed out guidance and free assessment services to utilities.
segments.tr: Agências federais de cibersegurança e meio ambiente, juntamente com a organização de compartilhamento de informações do próprio setor de água, enviaram orientações e serviços de avaliação gratuitos para as concessionárias.

segments.src: The immediate asks are unglamorous and specific: get control interfaces off the open internet, replace default credentials, turn on multifactor authentication for remote access, keep offline backups of controller configurations, and make sure someone knows who to call at 3 a.m.
segments.tr: As solicitações imediatas são simples e específicas: tirar as interfaces de controle da internet aberta, substituir as credenciais padrão, ativar a autenticação multifator para acesso remoto, manter backups offline das configurações do controlador e garantir que alguém saiba quem ligar às 3 da manhã.

segments.src: None of that is new advice.
segments.tr: Nada disso é um conselho novo.

segments.src: What may be new is the political attention.
segments.tr: O que pode ser novo é a atenção política.

segments.src: A single incident is a headline; dozens of utilities across seven states is a pattern, and patterns are what move budgets.
segments.tr: Um único incidente é uma manchete; dezenas de concessionárias em sete estados é um padrão, e padrões são o que movem orçamentos.

segments.src: For residents, there is no action to take and no reason to change anything about how you use your water.
segments.tr: Para os residentes, não há ação a tomar e nenhum motivo para mudar qualquer coisa sobre como você usa sua água.

segments.src: Local utilities are required to notify customers if drinking water ever fails to meet safety standards, and your annual water quality report remains the document that actually tells you about what you are drinking.
segments.tr: As concessionárias locais são obrigadas a notificar os clientes se a água potável deixar de atender aos padrões de segurança, e seu relatório anual de qualidade da água continua sendo o documento que realmente informa sobre o que você está bebendo.

segments.src: If you want to know how your own system is doing, that report — and the utility's board meetings, which are public — is where to look.
segments.tr: Se você quiser saber como seu próprio sistema está indo, esse relatório — e as reuniões do conselho da concessionária, que são públicas — é onde procurar.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: Nobody poisoned anybody's water.
segments.tr: Ninguém envenenou a água de ninguém.

segments.src: That deserves to be said plainly, because the alternative framing spreads fast and helps no one.
segments.tr: Isso merece ser dito claramente, porque a narrativa alternativa se espalha rápido e não ajuda ninguém.

segments.src: What did happen is that a lot of people discovered how many front doors there are, and how many of them were unlocked.
segments.tr: O que aconteceu foi que muitas pessoas descobriram quantas portas da frente existem e quantas delas estavam destrancadas.

segments.src: The defenses that kept this from becoming a public health event were largely the old ones — physical limits, chemistry, trained operators watching gauges.
segments.tr: As defesas que impediram que isso se tornasse um evento de saúde pública foram, em grande parte, as antigas — limites físicos, química, operadores treinados vigiando medidores.

segments.src: Those are good defenses.
segments.tr: Essas são boas defesas.

segments.src: They are also the last line, not the first.
segments.tr: Elas também são a última linha, não a primeira.

segments.src: The question this episode leaves behind is whether the country is willing to pay for a first line at 50,000 separate addresses.
segments.tr: A pergunta que este episódio deixa é se o país está disposto a pagar por uma primeira linha em 50.000 endereços separados.

segments.src: So far, that answer has been left to each of them individually.
segments.tr: Até agora, essa resposta foi deixada para cada um deles individualmente.

in.title: Seseorang Mengetuk Pasokan Air Amerika: Peretas Menyerang Utilitas di Tujuh Negara Bagian

segments.src: Federal investigators are examining a cluster of computer intrusions at municipal water systems spread across at least seven states, according to officials and state agencies that have confirmed cases in recent days.
segments.tr: Penyidik federal sedang memeriksa sekumpulan intrusi komputer pada sistem air kota yang tersebar di setidaknya tujuh negara bagian, menurut para pejabat dan lembaga negara bagian yang telah mengonfirmasi kasus-kasus tersebut dalam beberapa hari terakhir.

segments.src: Michigan authorities have said nine utilities in the state were affected.
segments.tr: Otoritas Michigan mengatakan sembilan utilitas di negara bagian tersebut terkena dampak.

segments.src: Minnesota's tally is larger — more than thirty systems flagged for review.
segments.tr: Jumlah di Minnesota lebih besar — lebih dari tiga puluh sistem yang ditandai untuk ditinjau.

segments.src: The message from officials so far has been consistent on one point: the drinking water itself is not known to have been altered, and there is no indication that anyone's tap is unsafe.
segments.tr: Pesan dari para pejabat sejauh ini konsisten pada satu poin: air minum itu sendiri tidak diketahui telah diubah, dan tidak ada indikasi bahwa keran siapa pun tidak aman.

segments.src: But the incidents have pulled back the curtain on something water professionals have been saying quietly for years.
segments.tr: Namun insiden ini telah membuka tabir tentang sesuatu yang telah dikatakan oleh para profesional air secara diam-diam selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: The United States does not have *a* water system.
segments.tr: Amerika Serikat tidak memiliki *sebuah* sistem air.

segments.src: It has tens of thousands of them, most of them small, most of them locally run, and many of them defended by a budget that would not cover a mid-size company's IT department.
segments.tr: Amerika memiliki puluhan ribu sistem, sebagian besar kecil, sebagian besar dikelola secara lokal, dan banyak dari mereka dipertahankan oleh anggaran yang bahkan tidak akan mencukupi untuk departemen IT perusahaan menengah.

segments.src: *This is a developing story.
segments.tr: *Ini adalah berita yang sedang berkembang.

segments.src: Details reported by state and federal agencies may change as investigations continue.*
segments.tr: Detail yang dilaporkan oleh lembaga negara bagian dan federal dapat berubah seiring berlanjutnya penyelidikan.*

segments.src: ## What officials have described
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dijelaskan oleh para pejabat

segments.src: The activity came to wider attention after a federal advisory warned that intruders were attempting to reach the operational side of water utilities — not the billing servers or the email accounts, but the systems that actually open valves, run pumps, and dose chemicals.
segments.tr: Aktivitas ini mendapat perhatian lebih luas setelah peringatan federal memperingatkan bahwa penyusup mencoba menjangkau sisi operasional dari utilitas air — bukan server penagihan atau akun email, tetapi sistem yang benar-benar membuka katup, menjalankan pompa, dan memberikan dosis kimia.

segments.src: State environmental and public safety agencies then began contacting utilities within their borders to check logs and equipment.
segments.tr: Lembaga lingkungan dan keselamatan publik negara bagian kemudian mulai menghubungi utilitas di dalam batas wilayah mereka untuk memeriksa log dan peralatan.

segments.src: Michigan's environment department confirmed nine affected systems.
segments.tr: Departemen lingkungan Michigan mengonfirmasi sembilan sistem yang terkena dampak.

segments.src: Minnesota officials described a broader review touching more than thirty.
segments.tr: Pejabat Minnesota menjelaskan tinjauan yang lebih luas yang menyentuh lebih dari tiga puluh sistem.

segments.src: Other states have acknowledged cases without publishing counts, and federal investigators are treating the incidents as part of one pattern rather than a string of coincidences.
segments.tr: Negara bagian lain telah mengakui adanya kasus tanpa mempublikasikan jumlahnya, dan penyidik federal memperlakukan insiden ini sebagai bagian dari satu pola, bukan sekadar rangkaian kebetulan.

segments.src: Officials have generally declined to name individual utilities, which is standard practice while an investigation is open.
segments.tr: Para pejabat umumnya menolak untuk menyebutkan nama utilitas secara individu, yang merupakan praktik standar saat penyelidikan masih terbuka.

segments.src: Publishing a list of systems with known weaknesses is, for obvious reasons, not something agencies rush to do.
segments.tr: Mempublikasikan daftar sistem dengan kelemahan yang diketahui, karena alasan yang jelas, bukanlah sesuatu yang terburu-buru dilakukan oleh lembaga-lembaga tersebut.

segments.src: What has been said publicly is narrow and worth reading literally: no confirmed change to water quality, no confirmed harm to any customer, and no confirmed disruption of service.
segments.tr: Apa yang dikatakan secara publik adalah sempit dan layak dibaca secara harfiah: tidak ada perubahan kualitas air yang dikonfirmasi, tidak ada bahaya yang dikonfirmasi bagi pelanggan mana pun, dan tidak ada gangguan layanan yang dikonfirmasi.

segments.src: That is not the same as saying nothing happened.
segments.tr: Itu tidak sama dengan mengatakan bahwa tidak ada yang terjadi.

segments.src: It means the consequences did not reach the water.
segments.tr: Itu berarti konsekuensinya tidak mencapai air.

segments.tr: ## Bagian dari utilitas yang jarang dipikirkan orang

segments.tr: Yang pertama adalah IT kantor biasa — email, penagihan, penggajian, portal pelanggan tempat Anda membayar tagihan.

segments.src: The intrusions under investigation appear to have involved that category of door: remotely reachable control interfaces, protected by whatever the utility had time and money to put in front of them.
segments.tr: Intrusi yang sedang diselidiki tampaknya melibatkan kategori pintu tersebut: antarmuka kontrol yang dapat dijangkau dari jarak jauh, dilindungi oleh apa pun yang dimiliki utilitas dalam hal waktu dan uang untuk dipasang di depannya.

segments.tr: Pengolahan air dibangun berdasarkan **redundansi**, dan itu dibangun dengan cara itu jauh sebelum siapa pun khawatir tentang peretas.
